subject: Data Engineering
title: Consumer Groups
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Consumer Groups.

hook.text: Three instances of the same service all read from one topic. But each event should be processed only once.

buildup.text: A consumer group ensures each partition is read by exactly one consumer in the group.

discovery.text: If a consumer crashes, Kafka reassigns its partitions to surviving members automatically.

twist.text: Multiple groups can read the same topic independently. Analytics and billing can each get every event.

climax.text: Consumer groups give you scalable, fault-tolerant consumption without duplicate processing.

punchline.text: One group, one copy. Many groups, many copies.

quiz.question: What happens when a consumer in a group crashes?
options: Its partitions are reassigned to surviving group members
